changes_made.explanation: Removed datasets that were only mentioned in related work/comparison tables but not used for evaluation. Removed duplicate 'DialogPT' model. Normalized capitalization of ReSee models and datasets. Consolidated output descriptions to 'dialogue responses'.
Normalized ROUGE variants to base form 'ROUGE'. Normalized Distinct metrics to full names. Removed abbreviated forms and consolidated metric variants.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper only mentions LLMs in the related work section but does not use them for evaluation.

guideline: Annotators rated responses on fluency, informativeness, relevance, sensibleness, and specificity using defined scoring systems with 5-point scales for fluency/informativeness/relevance and binary yes/no for sensibleness/specificity

changes_made.explanation: The extracted metadata accurately captures the human evaluation criteria and guidelines described in the paper.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on dialogue generation with multimodal (visual+text) inputs. It evaluates on two main datasets (ReSee-WoW and ReSee-DD) using both automatic metrics and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but included some datasets/models mentioned only in related work tables. Normalized metric names to standard forms.
